question: Name the Indian sportsman who became the youngest Gold Medalist at the "Khelo India" games in Shooting in 2019.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Abhinav Shaw**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Abhinav Shaw** became the youngest Gold Medalist at the Khelo India Youth Games in 2019 in the sport of shooting.
 
• At just 10 years old, he won the gold medal in the 10-meter air rifle mixed team event alongside his partner,
 
 
• breaking records as the youngest athlete to achieve this feat in the competition.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Manu Bhaker**
 
• Manu Bhaker is an accomplished Indian shooter who has won multiple gold medals in various national and international shooting competitions. However, she did not hold the title of the youngest gold medalist at the Khelo India Games in 2019.
 
• **Abhishek Verma**
 
• Abhishek Verma is a prominent Indian shooter who has won medals in several international events. He specializes in the 10-meter air pistol event but did not compete in the Khelo India Games in 2019 as the youngest gold medalist.
 
• **Abhinav Bindra**
 
• Abhinav Bindra is a renowned Indian shooter and an Olympic gold medalist, famous for his 2008 Olympic gold in the 10-meter air rifle event. However, he did not participate in the Khelo India Games in 2019.
